english.title: False statement to a constable re baggage / cargo / store - aviation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in answer to a question relating to baggage, cargo or stores, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..), intended for carriage by a civil aircraft registered or operating in the United Kingdom and which was put to you by a constable for purposes to which Part II of the Aviation Security Act 1982 applied, made a statement which you knew to be false in a material particular or recklessly made a statement which was false in a material particular in that **(..SPECIFY DETAILS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 21A(1) and (4) of the Aviation Security Act 1982.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See also offence wordings: H2705 and H2706.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
